limitations.text: At v20.0.24, flake.lock pins LiteLLM revision e484a7c89c4ced103645c33159d33922e7eac84a (https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/blob/v20.0.24/flake.lock). Its model_prices_and_context_window.json contains neither claude-opus-5-5 nor gpt-6-luna, including names containing either identifier. This supports the retained offline unpricedModels observations at the installed pin.

The release's bundled models.dev pricing file also contains neither claude-opus-5-5 nor gpt-6-luna. Updating the upstream registry or inspecting main does not refresh an already installed binary's embedded snapshots.

Custom pricing is already supported at the installed release: set defaults.pricingOverrides with raw model-name keys, including claude-opus-5-5 and gpt-6-luna, and supply verified input/output/cache rates. Overrides work with --offline; unspecified fields can fall back to zero when no upstream entry exists. No actual rates or resolved host costs were assumed in this research.

The online code path can refresh LiteLLM before applying user overrides; offline mode skips it. Availability of new upstream entries is therefore a supported remediation path, not evidence that the retained offline outputs are already priced.

The optional @ccusage/mcp package remains separately published at 18.0.11 and documents Claude usage analytics. Its documented protocol surface should not be presented as parity with the current CLI's Codex accounting.
